import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,io,base64
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
for i in range(1,23,2):
 imgs=[]
 for j in [i,i+1]:
  r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(j),'-l',str(j),'-scale-to','1500','-png','-singlefile','inputs/sources/design-final.pdf'],capture_output=True,timeout=15);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
  imgs.append(Image.open(io.BytesIO(r.stdout)).convert('RGB'))
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(sum(x.width for x in imgs),max(x.height for x in imgs)),'white');x=0
 for img in imgs: sheet.paste(img,(x,0));x+=img.width
 b=io.BytesIO();sheet.save(b,format='JPEG',quality=75)
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),f'visual/final-{i}-{i+1}.jpg','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 print('rendered',i,i+1)
